value.rationale: The natural two equal competing antagonistic shortcuts produce a comparison-principle failure at an unperturbed remote entry rather than at either modified edge. A closed exact threshold determines monotonicity for all n, separates it quantitatively from the positive-definite regime, and exhibits exponential fragility under increasing path length. This is a meaningful boundary of inverse-positivity-preserving perturbations for screened diffusion, distinct from mere algebraic checking or a one-off small matrix.
